==Information==
===Format===
* '''Group Stage''': ''August 20<sup>th</sup> - 23<sup>rd</sup>''
**Round Robin with 4 groups
**All matches are {{Ft|3}}
**{{Bgcolortext|up|Top 2 teams}} of each group advance to '''Playoffs'''
<ul><li>{{GeneralCollapsible|title=''Click Show for detailed information about the Group Draw and Tiebreakers''|boldTitle=false|contentClass=table2__table|content=
* '''Group Stage Draw'''<ref name="group draw">{{cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_lCIzOn4Z34|title=Group Stage Draw.|author='''[[Blizzard Entertainment]]'''|date=2026-07-15}}</ref>
** Teams cannot play against another team from their qualifier group
** A maximum of 2 teams per conference can be placed into a group
** If a team is pulled that can't abide by these rules, they will go into the next avaliable group
*** '''Pool 1''' consists of the [[Overwatch_World_Cup/2023|OWWC 2023]] Winner and Runner Up: {{Team|Saudi Arabia}} & {{Team|China}} 
*** '''Pool 2''' consists of 1st seed over all qualifiers:
**** '''Americas''': {{Team|Canada}} & {{Team|United States}}
**** '''EMEA''': {{Team|Sweden}}, {{Team|Germany}} & {{Team|France}}
**** '''Asia''': {{Team|South Korea}} & {{Team|Australia}} 
*** '''Pool 3''' consists of 2nd seed over all qualifiers: 
**** '''Americas''': {{Team|Colombia}} & {{Team|Mexico}}
**** '''EMEA''': {{Team|Denmark}}, {{Team|United Kingdom}} & {{Team|Spain}}
**** '''Asia''': {{Team|Japan}} & {{Team|Thailand}}
* '''Tiebreakers'''
*#Head-to-head Series Differential
*#Head-to-head Map Differential
*#Overall Map Differential
*#Overall Map Score % Differential
*#Strength of Victory evaluate by combining records between all teams
*#Tiebreaker Match
** Tiebreakers will be applied until a team prevails.
** Remaining tied teams start at the top of the list.
** This process is repeated until all teams are fully ranked
}}</li></ul>
* '''Playoffs''': ''September 12<sup>th</sup> - 13<sup>th</sup>''
**Single elimination bracket
**All matches ''(excl. Grand Finals)'' are {{Ft|3}}
**Grand Finals are {{Ft|4}}
*'''Hero Bans'''
**Each team bans 1 hero per map, with the ban impacting both teams
**Each ban must be from a different role than the other team's ban
**Teams can only ban a hero once per series, but may repeat a ban from the opposing team
**To determine ban priority for Map 1, a 1v1 Deathmatch is played between a player from each team. The winner of the 1v1 then chooses to either select the starting map or the first ban. Whichever option remains after the choice, the loser of the 1v1 selects.
**For Map 2 and onwards, the losing team of the previous map chooses to ban first or second.
